class APIError(QuickbaseError)
    def __init__(self, summary: str, *, status_code: int = 0, method: str = '', path: str = '', message: str | None = None, description: str | None = None, request_id: str | None = None) -> None
class App(object)
    def apply_schema_changes(self, plan: SchemaPlan) -> SchemaChangeResult
    def copy(self, name: str, *, description: str | None = None, keep_data: bool = False, keep_files: bool = False, keep_users: bool = False, assign_token: bool = True) -> 'App'
    def create_table(self, name: str, *, description: str | None = None, single_record_name: str | None = None, plural_record_name: str | None = None) -> 'Table'
    def drop(self, *, confirm: str) -> None
    def ensure_table(self, name: str, *, description: str | None = None, single_record_name: str | None = None, plural_record_name: str | None = None) -> 'Table'
    def events(self) -> list[AppEvent]
    property id -> str
    def info(self) -> AppInfo
    def operation(self, name: Literal['describe_schema', 'preview_schema_changes', 'apply_schema_changes'], *, max_changes: int = 20) -> 'SchemaOperation'
    def preview_schema_changes(self, changes: Sequence[CreateTable | UpdateTable | DeleteTable | CreateField | UpdateField | DeleteField | CreateRelationship | CreateLookupField | CreateSummaryField | DeleteRelationship]) -> SchemaPlan
    def roles(self, *, refresh: bool = False) -> list[Role]
    def settings_url(self) -> str
    def table(self, name_or_id: str) -> 'Table'
    def tables(self, *, refresh: bool = False) -> list[TableInfo]
    def url(self) -> str

    field name: str | None
    field owner: User | None
    field raw: Mapping[str, Any]
    property runs_on_changes -> bool
    field table_id: str | None
    field type: str
    field url: str | None

class BoundPolicy(object)
    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool
    def __init__(self, *, app_id: str | None, offline: bool, tables: Mapping[str, str], fields: Mapping[str, Mapping[int, str]], field_types: Mapping[str, Mapping[int, str]], classes: Mapping[str, Mapping[int, frozenset[str]]], rules: Sequence[pyquickbase._bound._Rule], custom: Sequence[Rule], rows: Mapping[str, tuple[str, str]], row_fields: Mapping[str, frozenset[int]], links: Sequence[pyquickbase._bound._Link], reports: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, tuple[str, str]]], new_fields: str, created: Sequence[tuple[str, str]] = ()) -> None
    def allows(self, verb: Literal['read', 'filter', 'sort', 'insert', 'update', 'delete', 'download', 'delete_file', 'report', 'run_formula', 'add_field', 'change_field', 'delete_field', 'formula', 'lookup', 'summary', 'link', 'unlink', 'change_table', 'delete_table', 'create_tables'], table: str, *, field: str | int | None = None, fields: Sequence[str | int] = (), source: tuple[str, str | int] | None = None) -> Decision
    def can_create_tables(self, app_id: str) -> bool
    def classes_of(self, table_id: str, field_id: int) -> frozenset[str]
    property created -> tuple[str, ...]
    property created_offers -> frozenset[str]
    def decide(self, request: ReadRequest | WriteRequest) -> Decision
    def deletion_effects(self, table_id: str, field_ids: Sequence[int] = (), *, table: bool = False) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], tuple[str, ...]]
    def emails_shown(self, table_id: str) -> bool
    def explain(self, verb: Literal['read', 'filter', 'sort', 'insert', 'update', 'delete', 'download', 'delete_file', 'report', 'run_formula', 'add_field', 'change_field', 'delete_field', 'formula', 'lookup', 'summary', 'link', 'unlink', 'change_table', 'delete_table', 'create_tables'], table: str, *, field: str | int | None = None, fields: Sequence[str | int] = (), source: tuple[str, str | int] | None = None) -> str
    def field_types(self, table_id: str) -> frozenset[str] | None
    def filterable(self, table_id: str, field_id: int) -> bool
    classmethod def from_json(cls, text: str, *, rules: Sequence[Rule] = ()) -> 'BoundPolicy'
    property hash -> str
    def hidden_labels(self, table_id: str) -> frozenset[str]
    def max_delete(self, table_id: str) -> int | None
    def max_records(self, table_id: str) -> int | None
    def max_summary_records(self, table_id: str) -> int | None
    def new_field_effects(self, table_id: str, sources: Sequence[tuple[str, int]] | None = ()) -> tuple[str, ...]
    def offers(self, table: str) -> Offers[Named]
    def offers_for(self, table_id: str, items: Sequence[tuple[~T, str]], field_id: Callable[[~T], int], reports: Sequence[Any] = (), report_key: Callable[[Any], tuple[str, str]] | None = None) -> Offers[~T]
    def readable(self, table_id: str, field_id: int) -> bool
    def row_limit(self, table_id: str) -> str | None
    def row_limit_rule(self, table_id: str) -> str | None
    def schema_tables(self) -> list[Named]
    def table_visible(self, table_id: str) -> bool
    def to_json(self) -> str
    def trim(self, request: ReadRequest | None, method: str, path: str, payload: Any) -> Any
    def user_emails(self, table_id: str) -> bool
    def visible(self, table_id: str, field_id: int) -> bool
    def with_created(self, table_id: str, name: str) -> 'BoundPolicy'
